sources.entry: plumio - Markdown notes taking app with live preview, document encryption, multi-user support, multi-organization capabilities and more. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: plumio is a self-hosted markdown note-taking editor with live preview, document encryption, and multi-user and multi-organization support.
summary.what_it_does: plumio is a self-hosted markdown editor aimed at individuals and teams who want private note-taking. It offers a live markdown preview and colorful, customizable item labels for organizing documents. Documents can be encrypted, and the README describes this as end-to-end encryption. Multiple user accounts can be created for collaboration, and multiple organizations can be managed within one instance. The README also describes webhooks for document create, update, delete, and move events, plus API key management for interacting with the API. An optional daily automated backup system with retention, manual backups, and backup logs is included. A desktop app for Windows and macOS is available from the releases page, and the README says it connects to a remote server.
use_cases: team note sharing with multiple accounts
organizing notes across multiple groups or organizations
how_to_run: Follow the self-hosting guide linked from the README docs site
notable: Webhooks and API key management for integrations
Optional daily automated backups with retention
caveats: Desktop app is unsigned, so macOS and Windows show security warnings that must be bypassed
Remote desktop connection requires adding app://plumio to the server's ALLOWED_ORIGINS variable
Changing the documents folder in settings triggers an error popup because the backend restarts
